name: aether
description: Scan files, hunt threats and pivot campaigns with MetaDefender Aether.
long_description:
**Scan files, hunt threats and pivot campaigns with MetaDefender Aether.**

• **Scan** files and URLs in the Aether sandbox (always private)  
• **Look up** the reputation of hashes, IPs, domains and URLs, up to 100 at once  
• **Search** reports by malware family, file type, behavior, MITRE technique, YARA rule or file name  
• **Pivot** to related samples, similar files and IOC prevalence  
• **Extract** IOCs, malware configs, emulated behavior, YARA hits, family attribution, MITRE ATT&CK techniques and page screenshots

**Try:**  
• "Is this IP malicious? 203.0.113.5"  
• "Scan ~/Downloads/invoice.pdf and tell me if it is malicious."  
• "Find AsyncRAT samples from this month and list their C2 servers."  
• "Map that sample to MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques."

_Sample files can never be downloaded._
